strategyReview: The house edge is real but needs localization: live Polymarket NO/sell-YES trades are working when gated tightly, the outcome panel shows YES-overpricing remains strongest in near-dated mid-priced contracts, and Weekend HL funding reversion long is still the largest eligible live family. The main failures are broad or mis-specified shadows: one-touch NO fades are being tested against spot-move predictions instead of contract premium decay, single-ticker weekend funding shadows are using a static -10% threshold that fires on flat/default funding prints, and HYPE/IV 'confirmation' longs are late-stage echoes rather than independent continuation signals.

failureClusters.evidence: H-534/GOLD one-touch shadow family is 3/16 scorable with 7 unscorable tests because the prediction says GOLD spot declines >2%, while the scorable outcomes are pm_contract_pnl moves that mostly show small premium decay. The contract edge does not require a 2% spot move.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author these as neutral contract-premium fades with direction=neutral and prediction about NO/YES price decay, never as spot-directional calls.

failureClusters.evidence: MU, AAPL, and CBRS shadow-mined weekend funding families are running 31%, 50%, and 46% wins respectively. Losses cluster on prints that start and stay at default 5.5% or resume lower, showing one reading below -10% is not an actionable exhaustion trigger.
failureClusters.recommendation: Kill or refine ticker-level < -10 clauses; use relative extreme z-score/percentile plus evidence of turning, and rely on the pooled weekend funding parent rather than ticker-specific repeats.

failureClusters.evidence: BTC listed-IV momentum confirmation is 4/18 (22% win) and cross-asset HYPE confirmation is 9/25 (36% win). The winning examples are mostly strong trend days, while losses show the confirmation is already priced or marks FOMO.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not promote HYPE spot/stability or rising options IV as BTC continuation confirmations. Invalidate the underlying confirmation assumption and stop spending tests on near-duplicate variants.

failureClusters.evidence: Broad ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO shadow cohort has 429 resolved at 46% win and avg -1.0%, while the panel/localized cuts show 60-81% win rates over meaningful n and the gated live trades are 4/4.
failureClusters.recommendation: Only promote NO/sell-YES entry when price band, days-to-expiry, spread, and model-edge conditions are explicit and contract-side. Keep broad shadow signals in shadow until such cuts pool enough family evidence.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: replace the spot-decline prediction with a contract premium fade on moderate GOLD above-strike one-touch sell-YES edge, near-dated contracts only.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / buying NO on the scoped GOLD above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 3 days as the rich touch premium decays.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: require CBRS funding to be in a relative extreme and already turning higher, avoiding the flat/default reads and continued deterioration that caused losses under the static < -10 rule.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot/perp will move >2% within 3 days as deeply stretched funding begins to normalize.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-535: replace static MU funding < -10 with a relative extreme that has started turning up; this filters entries at stale 5.5% prints and requires actual normalization to have begun.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU spot/perp will move >2% within 3 days as stretched funding begins to normalize.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: require AAPL funding to be in the lower tail and turning higher, rather than any print below -10%; this avoids losses from flat/default funding readings and focuses on genuine reversion starts.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot/perp will move >2% within 3 days as stretched funding begins to normalize.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The CBRS shadow family is 13/28 scorable (46% win), and losses show funding either stuck at 5.5% or continuing lower after the < -10 trigger; only a few genuine reversion starts produced wins.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single cbrs_hl_funding_ann reading below -10% is a sufficient timing trigger for a >2% CBRS spot move within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The cross-asset HYPE confirmation family is 9/25 (36% win). Wins cluster in already strong BTC trend windows, while many losses show HYPE risk-on participation fails to add timing value and behaves as a lagging echo.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation that BTC upside continuation, rather than late-stage risk-on participation, will continue.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL shadow tests are 10/20 (50% win). The losses include multiple starts and ends at 5.5% or starts at 11.2% reverting to 5.5%, showing the static < -10 trigger is too blunt and often captures neutral/default funding states.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The BTC listed-IV momentum family is 4/18 (22% win). Rising 30d options IV alongside positive spot momentum repeatedly failed to deliver >2% continuation, and some variants scored as shorts during large rally losses.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC spot momentum above its short-term moving average near the 7d high, confirmed by rising listed option IV, reliably leads to further >2% spot gains.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The GOLD one-touch high-edge NO family is 3/16 scorable with 7 unscorable tests. The scorable examples are contract pnl moves, not GOLD spot moves, confirming the primary prediction was written against the wrong instrument.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge of at least 10 points on one-touch contracts predicts a >2% decline in GOLD spot within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU shadow tests are 5/16 (31% win). Many losses start and finish at the same 5.5% funding value, meaning the signal fired on a flat/default print rather than a tradable stress event.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single mu_hl_funding_ann reading below -10% reliably predicts normalization and a >2% MU spot gain within 2 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's review confirms the priority should be localization, not new broad signals. The panel findings continue to show the YES-overpricing edge is concentrated in mid-priced, near-dated, tight-spread contracts; broad one-touch shadows lose largely because they are not gated or are graded on the wrong instrument. The weekend funding parent remains strong, but ticker-level shadow variants using static -10% thresholds are failing. Several momentum confirmation families are now definitively invalidated and should not be re-proposed. Refinements this run focus on rewriting the GOLD one-touch edge as a contract fade and replacing static funding triggers with relative tail plus turn conditions.
